title: Pasta: Proportional Amplitude Spectrum Training Augmentation for Syn-to-Real Domain Generalization
mechanism: Perturb the Fourier amplitude spectrum with jitter that grows with frequency, keeping phase, to generate augmented views.
adaptation: Source-free counterpart of FDA: phase kept so crack positions are unchanged; cap the high-frequency jitter so faint cracks (7% are under 2% darker) survive. Aimed at E1 and weak sources BMRK/CFVS.
min_experiment: Arm: house + PASTA; baseline house; 5 seeds; E1 relF1@2, per-source crack IoU; kill if E1 relF1@2 < +0.03; run beside FDA with shared code.
evidence: R: beats more complex DG methods on 5 syn-to-real shifts incl. GTAV-to-real segmentation; complementary to them.
prior_overlap: none; house augmentation is brightness/contrast only
